Euro Sign Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Euro Sign is 0128. Hold Alt, type 0128 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Euro Sign also has the Unicode codepoint U+20AC, so you can type it with Alt+8364 on Windows, search for U+20AC in macOS's Character Viewer, use € in HTML, or \20AC in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥⇧2 for Euro Sign; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity € for Euro Sign, but the numeric form € is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type euro sign on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 2 8 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Euro Sign character (€) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type euro sign on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥⇧2 to insert Euro Sign. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Euro Sign" and click the character.

How to use euro sign in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\20AC"; ()
  • Python: \u20AC or chr(0x20AC)
  • JavaScript: \u20AC or String.fromCodePoint(0x20AC)
  • JSON: "\u20AC"
  • LaTeX: $\euro$ (text mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Euro Sign?

The legacy Alt code for Euro Sign is 0128. Hold Alt, type 0 1 2 8 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type € without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as €, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8364 not work?

Alt+8364 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Euro Sign?

The Unicode codepoint for Euro Sign is U+20AC. You can use this value in HTML as €, in CSS as \20AC, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type € on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥⇧2. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+20AC.
